game.name: New Super Mario Bros.
game.rules:
All runs require video proof. Any runs verified without video proof prior to September 2022 will remain untouched.

Twitch Highlights are not accepted as adequate video proof as of April 2025 due to risk of deletion. Any other video uploading service is acceptable, but YouTube is strongly recommended.

All official release runs must be done on either a cartridge of New Super Mario Bros. or on the Wii U Virtual Console (Wii U VC) release. Playing off of flash cartridges (R4 card, etc.) or off of an SD card through DSi/3DS Homebrew (Twilight Menu+ +, etc.) is not allowed for runs due to loading time inconsistencies. When submitting a run done on an official release, make sure you select the “Official Releases” sub-category.

All emulator runs must be done on either DeSmuME version 0.9.11 or later, or melonDS version 0.9.5 or later on a computer. Mobile phone emulators of any kind are not allowed. When submitting a run done on emulator ensure you select the “Emulator” sub-category and set the platform to “Nintendo DS” with the emulator box checked. **Since different emulator versions have different loading times, please include your emulator's version in either the video of your run (recommended) or in the description of your run. Not providing the emulator version may lead to the maximum loading time being added to your run or the run being rejected.**

WiiUVC and emulator have faster loading times than DS so time is added on to these runs in the “Time with loads” column. When submitting a run done on WiiUVC or emulator, put your real time in the “Time without loads” column and then add on the amount specified in the category rules to your time in the “Time with loads” column. For runs done on DS put your real time in both columns. The leaderboards are ranked by the "Time with loads" column, which is the one with the time added on.

**Please make sure you have also read the Category Rules tab before submitting to a category.**

**If you choose to run on DS/3DS, friendly reminder that you don't need a capture card to submit your runs. Using a phone camera/computer webcam/anything similar pointed at your DS/3DS screen works perfectly fine as well. If you need help with finding a good recording setup, come ask in our Discord server (linked at the top).**

relatedGames.name: New Super Mario Bros. Category Extensions
relatedGames.rules:
No Emulators allowed for category extentions, they add inconsistent loads, and we are not manually retiming loads for category extensions. (Effective 11/1/24), any previously verified emulator runs will be grandfathered in.


For the sake of the mods, if possible try to upload your runs to YouTube (if you stream on twitch you can export highlights to YouTube), it makes it much easier for us to retime when submitting for the shorter categories. Thank you. :)

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
Beat the level using any exit.

**Runs are timed by subtracting the full time given at the start of the level from the time you have when you finish the level. Enter your time in the “time without loads” column and leave the “time with loads” column blank.** For example: if the level starts with 400 on the in-game timer and you finish the level with 349 then your time is 51 seconds. 400 - 349 = 51.

You may not use the halfway flag (you must complete the level in one go).

All runs require video proof.

Beat the level using any exit while collecting all 3 coins.

**Runs are timed by subtracting the full time given at the start of the level from the time you have when you finish the level. You may not use the halfway flag (you must complete the level in one go).

All runs require video proof.

Beat the game and get three stars on the save file. This includes collecting and spending every star coin, beating all levels (including cannons) and completing all secret exits.

Oh boy. Not bad for one of the first completed runs. No recording because it is not possible for me to sit for 25 minutes cramped behind my DS and holding it without shaking too much... So a little description of my run. Split timings are when the first frame outside of the stage / world appears. (Example: the split of world 5 was timed when the first frame of the world 5 map appeared) 
1-1: As good as it can be 370 finish.
1-2: Got blue shell not bad but could be done better.
1-T: Got fast cycle but got a pixel stop in the room with the second starcoin.
5-1: Could be a bit faster with more unmorphing but overall ok.
5-2: Used safe strat in the jump after the piranha plants but other than that ok.
5-3: 365 finish. As good as it could be.
5-G: Could be done a lot faster but it was ok.
8-1: 369 finish. Not bad...
8-2: Played normally. Potential for improvement is there.
8-T: Got the first cycle. But can't do the Bowser Jr Quickkill so at least there could be a 20-30 second improvement.
8-3: Ok run... 
8-4: Played a bit safer with less unmorphing.
8-C: Grabbed a flower for backup. Lost shell in Bowser jump.
8-5: Refilled to fire and grabbed another fire flower.
8-6: Choked a bit but nothing too bad.
8-7: Ok run
8-8: Grrrr... Died somehow in the beginning but didn't lost a ton of time (Lost maybe 10-15 seconds)
8-T-2: Not bad. Used death boosting. 
8-Final-Castle: Played a bit more safe in the level and didn't do the Bowser Jr. jump. Killed with fire. (Bowser didn't jump :( ) (Potential loss: 30-45 seconds)
Overall not a bad run for the first real one. (Had a 28:16 before) But I'm going for sub 25 since I only used casual strategies besides the death boost. :)
